errors.text_span: Стълбите са подредени в низходящ ред според височината им
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are sorted in descending order of their height (length). However, the bars are presented in the order: 'Над 5 г.' (~38.0%), '3 – 5 г.' (~31.5%), and 'Под 3 г.' (~31.0%). While the values themselves are in descending order, the bars are not reordered on the chart to reflect this; they are presented according to the logical order of the categories on the y-axis (from the longest time period to the shortest).

errors.text_span: като най-дългият е за най-дългия период на развитие, а най-късият — за най-краткия
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the correlation between bar length and time period. While factually correct, it is a separate observation from the sorting of the bars themselves. Combining it with the incorrect sorting claim makes the sentence confusing and less clear. It would be better to state the order of the categories on the axis first, and then describe the values for each.
